A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dolomites in the Moravo- Silesian basin were formed during the Variscan orogeny, and the fluid inclusions were trapped in a later post-Variscal period.

the fluid flow in the Moravo-silesian Basin was driven by a combination of evaporative concentration of brines in a restricted basin and fluid-rock interactions, which controlled the fluid composition at the low w/r ratios.
